top_signals.title: America Is Betting Big on a New Generation of Small Nuclear Reactors
top_signals.summary: Governments worldwide are racing to develop small modular reactors (SMRs) as part of their plans for a nuclear power renaissance, with significant progress being seen in recent years. However, the United States appears to be leading the way in nuclear microreactor development, with significant investment in the technology recently announced by the U.S. Army.
